The Chinese characters for Levi

As a transliteration, Levi is usually written 利瓦伊 (Lì wǎ yī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

利
Lì
sharp, benefit
瓦
wǎ
tile
伊
yī
he, she (classical)

Origin and meaning

Levi is a Hebrew name meaning “joined, attached”.

About the name Levi

In the Bible, Levi was one of Jacob's twelve sons and ancestor of the priestly tribe.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “joined, attached”, a Levi calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
